overall_reason: An untinted grey scale carries the share dialog (#222222 title, #444444 labels, a light grey title bar and pill), with one near-black #333333 'Copy link' button.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES and T-NEUTRALS pass with two text levels and one temperature; T-LINE-DELETION finds the title bar marked by both a tint and a hairline, and the document row boxed with a border and a fill.

findings.title: Regions use the lowest rung of the surface ladder
findings.where: title bar, 'Launch brief' row and footer rule, 1440, tiles/1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The title bar has a grey fill and a hairline below it; the 'Launch brief' row is a bordered box with its own pale fill inside the dialog; a second hairline sets off the footer. Hiding the title-bar hairline or the row's border loses no grouping.
findings.before: A tint plus a hairline on the title bar, and a bordered, filled box for a single row.
findings.after: One rung per seam: a tint or a hairline, and the document row as plain text with its icon.
findings.why: Doubled separators add weight to a small dialog without adding structure.

strengths: The near-black #333333 fill is used once, on the primary action.
One untinted grey family and no shadow.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
